unitTitle: Adverbs of Frequency - Past Simple - Used to - So - Neither/Nor

pairsWith.noteUz: 2-unit yakuniy mashqlari: used to, So/Neither, 1-2-unitlar takrori (Revision).

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 2-UNIT MAShQLAR, 3-BET (13-bet, PDF 12). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '2'.

4 The Japanese is/are friendly and kind people. 5 Does he know/knows Tom? 6 Did/Do you do the washing-up last Tuesday? 7 My mother used to wear/wore contact lenses.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the prompts, then ask and answer questions, as in the example. (Sally) long hair ✗ → A: Did Sally use to have long hair? B: No, she didn't. 1 glasses ✓ 2 cat ✗ 3 dolls ✓ 4 bicycle ✓ 5 computer ✗
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarga qarang, so'ng savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. (Salli) uzun soch ✗ → A: Salli ilgari uzun sochli edimi? B: Yo'q. 1 ko'zoynak ✓ 2 mushuk ✗ 3 qo'g'irchoqlar ✓ 4 velosiped ✓ 5 kompyuter ✗
exercises.explanationUz:
USED TO - SAVOL VA QISQA JAVOB.

  A: Did Sally USE to have ...?
  B: Yes, she DID. / No, she
     DIDN'T.

  ✓ → Yes, she did.
  ✗ → No, she didn't.

  ⚠ Savolda 'use to' (-d siz).
exercises.exampleEn: A: Did Sally use to have long hair? B: No, she didn't.
exercises.exampleUz: A: Salli ilgari uzun sochli edimi? B: Yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using so or neither/nor, as in the examples. Example: A: I speak Italian. B: So do I. (I) — A: Sue never goes to school by bus. B: Neither/Nor does Jo. (Jo)
exercises.instructionUz: So yoki neither/nor bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. Namuna: A: I speak Italian. B: So do I. (I) — A: Sue never goes to school by bus. B: Neither/Nor does Jo. (Jo)
exercises.explanationUz:
SO / NEITHER - YORDAMChI FE'LNI
  TOPISh.

  Tasdiq → SO + yordamchi + ega
  Inkor (never, can't, don't,
  didn't, doesn't) → NEITHER/NOR +
  yordamchi + ega

  1 speak → So DO I
  2 never goes → Neither DOES Jo
  3 goes → So DO I
  4 can't → Neither CAN Fred
  5 don't like → Neither DO I
  6 watched → So DID we
  7 didn't buy → Neither DID Bob
  8 lives → So DOES Pierre
  9 doesn't know → Neither DO I
  10 always does → So DOES Tim

  ⚠ 'never' - inkor ma'nosi →
  Neither.

items.textEn: Dad 's fixing/fixes our car at the moment.
Norwegians really loving/love the outdoors.
items.uz: Norvegiyaliklar ochiq havoni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

items.textEn: Has/Have he got freckles?
The Japanese is/are friendly and kind people.
Does he know/knows Tom?
Did/Do you do the washing-up last Tuesday?

exercises.explanationUz:
1-2-UNITLAR TESTI.

  1 I'm LOOKING for (hozir)
  2 FINISHED (an hour ago)
  3 USED to smoke (endi chekmaydi)
  4 CAN I come (so'rov)
  5 They ARE flying (reja)
  6 What DO you usually do
  7 yesterday I TOOK the bus
  8 He HAS got
  9 I USED to go skiing
  10 I rarely EAT fish (odat,
     'I' → -s yo'q)


⚠ 'TO LOOK FOR':

  = qidirmoq.


⚠ 'COPENHAGEN':

  = Kopengagen (Daniya poytaxti).

items.textEn: Excuse me, I'm ___ for Mrs Smith.
I ___ cooking an hour ago.
items.uz: Men bir soat oldin ovqat pishirishni tugatdim.

items.textEn: He ___ to smoke but he doesn't anymore.
items.uz: U ilgari chekardi, lekin endi chekmaydi.

items.textEn: ___ I come to the park with you?
They ___ flying to Copenhagen in two hours.
items.uz: Ular ikki soatdan keyin Kopengagenga uchishadi.

items.textEn: What ___ you usually do in the evenings?
I always drive to work but yesterday I ___ the bus.
items.uz: Men ishga har doim mashinada boraman, lekin kecha avtobusga chiqdim.

items.textEn: He ___ got two brothers and a sister.
items.uz: Uning ikki akasi va bir singlisi bor.

items.textEn: I ___ to go skiing but I don't anymore.
items.uz: Ilgari chang'i uchardim, lekin endi uchmayman.

items.textEn: I rarely ___ fish.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the words into the correct order.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'Z TARTIBI - RAVISh VA USED TO.

  1 Pete never drives to work.
  2 Tania usually goes out with
    friends on a Saturday night.
  3 They are always talking in
    class. ('to be' dan keyin
    always)
  4 She used to go to the
    hairdresser's once a week.
  5 Mike didn't use to have a
    beard.


⚠ 'THE HAIRDRESSER'S':

  = sartaroshxona (kitobda
  'hairdesser's' - matbaa xatosi).


⚠ 'ONCE A WEEK':

  = haftada bir marta.

items.answer: Tania usually goes out with friends on a Saturday night.
items.whyUz: ⚠ usually - fe'ldan oldin; 'on a Saturday night' oxirida.

items.answer: They are always talking in class.
She used to go to the hairdresser's once a week.
items.whyUz: ⚠ used to go to ...; vaqt oxirida.

items.answer: Mike didn't use to have a beard.

patterns.formula: A: ... can't / don't / didn't ... B: Neither + can / do / did + KIM.
patterns.exampleEn: A: Tom can't drive a car. B: Neither can Fred.
patterns.exampleUz: A: Tom mashina hayday olmaydi. B: Fred ham.

patterns.formula: Did + KIM + use to have + NIMA? — Yes, ... did. / No, ... didn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Did Sally use to have glasses? — Yes, she did.

patterns.formula: KIM + are + always + V-ing (to be dan keyin ravish)
patterns.exampleEn: They are always talking in class.
